one_sentence_story: A single world event is woven into a luminous audit braid, separated from interpretation inside a transparent Context Capsule, and closed as a falsifiable S6 paper claim only when the braid returns with a world-trace receipt.

beats.title: Source enters the loom
beats.causal_move: A source artifact emits one amber event bead; the bead is the only new moving object.
beats.visual: Place a warm paper card on the left hex tile with readable labels SOURCE ARTIFACT and EVENT 01. A thin amber filament leaves its lower edge.
beats.caption: Start with the thing that happened, not the conclusion.

beats.title: Evidence becomes traceable
beats.causal_move: The amber filament becomes a two-rail luminous stream and crosses one measured checkpoint.
beats.visual: Animate the bead along parallel amber and cyan rails over dark hexagonal ground. Show only WORLD TRACE and a small unfilled receipt ring; add no dashboard widgets.
beats.caption: The trace is a path through the world, not a decorative glow.

beats.title: Context is held apart
beats.causal_move: The stream passes through a transparent capsule that contains context while the source card remains outside it.
beats.visual: Grow a glass rectangular capsule at center around the rails. Reveal three readable tokens inside: CONTEXT, SCOPE, TIME. Keep SOURCE ARTIFACT outside the glass.
beats.caption: Context can travel with evidence without becoming the evidence.

beats.title: Geometry is proposed
beats.causal_move: A six-sided cusp fibre grows from the capsule exit and reveals a torus family labeled as a proposal, not a result.
beats.visual: Extrude a small hexagonal cusp at the capsule exit, then sweep the cyan rail into three concentric torus loops. Show PROPOSED GEOMETRY while the amber source rail stays unbroken.
beats.caption: The shape is a model of the trace, not proof by appearance.
beats.object_state: source_artifact=outside_capsule; evidence_stream=two_rail_continuous; context_capsule=transparent; torus_family=three_loops; cusp_fibre=hexagonal; s6_claim=paper_claim_pending

beats.title: Claim closes with a receipt
beats.causal_move: The torus family closes into an S6 loop only after the world-trace ring fills; the final label preserves uncertainty.
beats.visual: Pulse the checkpoint ring, then close the torus/cusp path into a hex-cusped loop. Put S6 PAPER CLAIM inside and RECEIPT: WORLD TRACE 01 below. End with source, capsule, braid, and loop visible.
beats.caption: S6 is shown as a paper claim backed by a trace receipt, not as consensus fact.
beats.object_state: source_artifact=anchored; evidence_stream=closed_braid; context_capsule=transparent; torus_family=closed_loop; cusp_fibre=hexagonal; s6_claim=explicit_paper_claim; receipt=world_trace_01

caption_script: 2 / Let one event leave a world trace.
3 / Carry context, but keep it separate.
4 / Treat the torus and cusp as proposed geometry.
5 / Close S6 only as a paper claim with a world-trace receipt.

manim_plan.determinism: No randomness; fixed coordinates, fixed z-order, fixed colors, and explicit animation durations
timing: 0.0-4.0s: FadeIn source card; Create one amber bead and filament.
4.0-8.0s: Transform filament into two rails; Move bead across checkpoint ring.
8.0-12.5s: Grow capsule; FadeIn CONTEXT, SCOPE, TIME tokens.
12.5-18.0s: Extrude hex cusp; Create three torus loops; FadeIn PROPOSED GEOMETRY.
18.0-24.0s: Pulse receipt ring; close loop; FadeIn S6 PAPER CLAIM and RECEIPT: WORLD TRACE 01.
manim_plan.camera: Orthographic fixed camera; no cuts; slow 2D parallax only on ground hex tiles
manim_plan.text_rule: Use only listed short labels; render them as real text with high contrast and no pseudo-text

falsifier: If the source artifact, context capsule, torus/cusp geometry, or final S6 label can appear without the world-trace receipt pulse, the causal story is false; if the receipt is not independently resolvable to a World snapshot/event, the visual supports only a proposed paper claim and must not be presented as consensus evidence.
